_comment: BURN-DOWN list for check-dependency-audit.mjs: advisories open in the locked production tree that this repo cannot currently close. An entry is allowed only when there is no published fix to move to, or when a parent pins the vulnerable version and cannot be overridden. Every entry MUST carry a note saying which parent brings the package in, what release it waits on, and the date that was last checked — without it the next reader has to re-derive the entire tree. Reaching a package through a transitive path is not on its own a reason to list it: where a fixed version is published, pin it with pnpm.overrides in ctf/package.json as "package@exact-installed-version": "fixed", so the entry stops matching once the parent moves on. The list may only ever shrink: the gate fails on a new advisory not listed here AND on a listed advisory that no longer applies. Never add an entry to silence the gate; update the dependency instead.

1239765.title: image-size: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
1239765.note: The fix is published only in 2.0.3 and later, and 2.x is not a drop-in replacement: its main export accepts only image bytes, while Metro Assets.js passes a file path for every image asset, so an override would break the mobile bundle. Installed at 1.2.1 through Metro inside Expo (metro 0.83.5 / 0.83.7 / 0.84.4 under packages/mobile), a build-time path this repo does not choose a version for. Newer Metro (0.87) no longer depends on image-size; remove once Expo moves to it. Checked 2026-10-03.

1239766.title: image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
1239766.note: Same as 1239765: the fix is only in 2.x, whose main export no longer accepts the file path Metro passes. Installed at 1.2.1 through Metro inside Expo (metro 0.83.5 / 0.83.7 / 0.84.4 under packages/mobile), a build-time path this repo does not choose a version for. Remove once Expo moves to a Metro release without image-size. Checked 2026-10-03.

1240912.title: node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements
1240912.note: No patched version is published: the advisory covers <=1.4.0 and 1.4.0 is the latest release. Installed at 1.4.0 through @expo/code-signing-certificates under @expo/cli in packages/mobile, a build-time tool. Remove as soon as node-forge ships a fix (then pin it with an override if Expo has not moved). Checked 2026-10-03.

1240991.title: http-cache-semantics max-stale handling can disclose cross-user cached responses
1240991.note: No patched version is published: the advisory covers <=4.2.0 and 4.2.0 is the latest release. Installed at 4.2.0 through make-fetch-happen 15.0.5 under unleash-client 6.11.0 in packages/web, which fetches feature-flag settings for the server only, not member responses. Remove as soon as http-cache-semantics ships a fix. Checked 2026-10-03.

1240992.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
1240992.note: No patched version is published: the advisory covers <=3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the latest release. Installed at 3.0.3 through micromatch 4.0.8 under Metro and Jest inside react-native in packages/mobile, build-time paths that only see patterns from this repo. Remove as soon as braces ships a fix. Checked 2026-10-03.
